HELP.TITLE: Handler Methods Help
HELP.WHAT_ARE_HANDLERS_DESCRIPTION: Handler methods are Ruby methods in the bot service that process conversation states, respond to user inputs, and manage the bot's behavior.
HELP.HOW_TO_SELECT_DESCRIPTION: Browse or search for a handler method, view its details to understand what it does, then select it to assign it to your state node.
HELP.HANDLER_TYPES_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Different handler types serve different purposes. State handlers manage conversation flow, keyword handlers respond to specific phrases, interactive handlers process user selections, and action handlers perform operations.
HELP.BEST_PRACTICES_DESCRIPTION: Use descriptive handler method names, check dependencies before assigning handlers, prefer stable handlers for production flows, and test handlers thoroughly before deployment.
